up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL3371 (5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 6) with the following constraints: target must be a single-protein type and organism must be human (tax_id 9606); activity must have standard_type='IC50', standard_relation='=', and a non-null pChEMBL value. For each matching row, return: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3371'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id ASC,
  ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
